{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ChatServer where

import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Network.Mail.Mime
import Network.Mail.SMTP (sendMail', Address(..))
import Data.Char (ord, chr)

type TenantId = Text
type UserId = Text
type RoomId = Text

data ChatMessage = ChatMessage
  { msgSender   :: UserId
  , msgTenant   :: TenantId
  , msgRoom     :: RoomId
  , msgBody     :: Text
  , msgMetadata :: Map Text Text
  } deriving (Show)

data NotificationConfig = NotificationConfig
  { ncSmtpHost    :: String
  , ncSmtpPort    :: Int
  , ncFromAddress :: Address
  , ncAdminEmail  :: Text
  }

data TenantState = TenantState
  { tsUsers       :: Map UserId UserProfile
  , tsRooms       :: Map RoomId [UserId]
  , tsNotifyPrefs :: Map UserId NotifyPref
  }

data UserProfile = UserProfile
  { upDisplayName :: Text
  , upEmail       :: Text
  , upTenantId    :: TenantId
  } deriving (Show)

data NotifyPref = NotifyEmail | NotifyNone deriving (Eq, Show)

-- Normalize unicode for tenant isolation checks
normalizeTenantId :: Text -> Text
normalizeTenantId = T.toLower . T.strip

-- Validate tenant boundary: ensure sender belongs to tenant
validateTenantAccess :: TenantState -> ChatMessage -> Bool
validateTenantAccess ts msg =
  case Map.lookup (msgSender msg) (tsUsers ts) of
    Nothing -> False
    Just profile -> normalizeTenantId (upTenantId profile) == normalizeTenantId (msgTenant msg)

-- Encode display name for email header using RFC 2047 Q-encoding
-- This handles special characters in display names
encodeDisplayName :: Text -> Text
encodeDisplayName name
  | T.all isSafeHeaderChar name = name
  | otherwise = T.concat ["=?UTF-8?Q?", qEncode name, "?="]
  where
    isSafeHeaderChar c = ord c >= 32 && ord c <= 126 && c /= '=' && c /= '?' && c /= '_'

-- Q-encoding implementation
qEncode :: Text -> Text
qEncode = T.concatMap encodeChar
  where
    encodeChar ' ' = "_"
    encodeChar c
      | ord c >= 33 && ord c <= 126 && c /= '=' && c /= '?' && c /= '_' = T.singleton c
      | otherwise = T.pack $ concatMap (\b -> "=" ++ hexByte b) (BS.unpack $ TE.encodeUtf8 $ T.singleton c)
    hexByte b = [hexDigit (fromIntegral b `div` 16), hexDigit (fromIntegral b `mod` 16)]
    hexDigit n
      | n < 10    = chr (ord '0' + n)
      | otherwise = chr (ord 'A' + n - 10)

-- Build notification subject with room context
buildSubject :: ChatMessage -> UserProfile -> Text
buildSubject msg sender =
  T.concat ["[Chat] New message from ", upDisplayName sender, " in ", msgRoom msg]

-- Sanitize header value - removes CR/LF to prevent header injection
sanitizeHeaderValue :: Text -> Text
sanitizeHeaderValue = T.filter (\c -> c /= '\r' && c /= '\n')

-- Build the Reply-To header from message metadata
-- Uses the sender's configured reply address or falls back to display name
buildReplyTo :: ChatMessage -> UserProfile -> Text
buildReplyTo msg sender =
  case Map.lookup "reply-preference" (msgMetadata msg) of
    Just pref -> sanitizeHeaderValue pref
    Nothing   -> upEmail sender

-- Core notification dispatch - sends email to offline users
notifyOfflineUsers :: NotificationConfig -> TenantState -> ChatMessage -> IO ()
notifyOfflineUsers config ts msg = do
  case Map.lookup (msgSender msg) (tsUsers ts) of
    Nothing -> return ()
    Just senderProfile -> do
      let roomUsers = maybe [] id $ Map.lookup (msgRoom msg) (tsRooms ts)
      mapM_ (notifyUser config ts msg senderProfile) roomUsers

notifyUser :: NotificationConfig -> TenantState -> ChatMessage -> UserProfile -> UserId -> IO ()
notifyUser config ts msg senderProfile uid = do
  case (Map.lookup uid (tsUsers ts), Map.lookup uid (tsNotifyPrefs ts)) of
    (Just recipient, Just NotifyEmail) | uid /= msgSender msg -> do
      let subject = buildSubject msg senderProfile
          replyTo = buildReplyTo msg senderProfile
          customHeaders = buildCustomHeaders msg senderProfile
          mail = buildMail config recipient subject replyTo customHeaders (msgBody msg)
      sendNotification config mail
    _ -> return ()

-- Build custom X-headers for threading and tenant context
buildCustomHeaders :: ChatMessage -> UserProfile -> [(BS.ByteString, Text)]
buildCustomHeaders msg sender =
  [ ("X-Chat-Tenant", sanitizeHeaderValue $ msgTenant msg)
  , ("X-Chat-Room", sanitizeHeaderValue $ msgRoom msg)
  , ("X-Chat-Sender", sanitizeHeaderValue $ upDisplayName sender)
  , ("X-Chat-Thread", sanitizeHeaderValue $ buildThreadId msg)
  ]

-- Thread ID construction for email threading
buildThreadId :: ChatMessage -> Text
buildThreadId msg =
  let base = T.concat [msgTenant msg, "/", msgRoom msg]
      -- Include sanitized correlation ID if present
      correlationId = sanitizeHeaderValue $ Map.findWithDefault "" "correlation-id" (msgMetadata msg)
  in T.concat [base, "@", correlationId, ".chat.internal"]

buildMail :: NotificationConfig -> UserProfile -> Text -> Text -> [(BS.ByteString, Text)] -> Text -> Mail
buildMail config recipient subject replyTo customHeaders body =
  let toAddr = Address (Just $ upDisplayName recipient) (upEmail recipient)
      baseMail = simpleMail' toAddr (ncFromAddress config) (sanitizeHeaderValue subject) (BL.fromStrict $ TE.encodeUtf8 body)
      -- Add custom headers including the thread ID
      withHeaders = foldr (\(name, val) m -> addHeader name val m) baseMail customHeaders
  in withHeaders
  where
    addHeader :: BS.ByteString -> Text -> Mail -> Mail
    addHeader name value mail =
      mail { mailHeaders = (TE.decodeUtf8 name, value) : mailHeaders mail }

sendNotification :: NotificationConfig -> Mail -> IO ()
sendNotification config mail =
  sendMail' (ncSmtpHost config) (ncSmtpPort config) mail

-- Process incoming message with full tenant isolation
processMessage :: MVar (Map TenantId TenantState) -> NotificationConfig -> ChatMessage -> IO (Either Text ())
processMessage stateVar config msg = do
  states <- readMVar stateVar
  let tenantId = normalizeTenantId (msgTenant msg)
  case Map.lookup tenantId states of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Unknown tenant"
    Just ts ->
      if validateTenantAccess ts msg
        then do
          notifyOfflineUsers config ts msg
          return $ Right ()
        else return $ Left "Tenant access denied"
